answer: I also use AI for understanding unfamiliar codebases, summarizing large documentation or pull requests, and exploring different implementation approaches before deciding on a solution. It’s helpful for quickly comparing patterns, validating ideas, and speeding up initial exploration when working with new parts of a framework.
We don't use Wagtail AI, because when we tried it, it was hard to set up and its feature set was very limited (and still is to a degree, compares to more mainstream CMS)
This survey suggested to me ways I could be using AI in development that I hadn't thought of. Thanks for the tips.
As a force multiplier AI is best used as a junior... don't trust it to go whole hog.  Not feeling the 'vibe' when my job could be on the line.

My favorite tooling is Codex and I use https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp to let Codex access the browser.

I disable Copilot most of the time (more in the way, than a help)

I use ChatGPT for ideation, brainstorming, architecture.
implement sometimes snippets of AI in interface
